Talent0_2Ability.name: 全量演算
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: 使用火箭主动攻击后，对命中的目标立即施加<color=#F74848>1</color>层<buf ID=4012502>[析构]</buf>，可叠加<color=#F74848>10</color>层；火箭的负重降低<color=#F74848>130</color>

Talent3_5Ability.name: 全量演算
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
使用火箭主动攻击后，对命中的目标立即施加<color=#F74848>1</color>层<buf ID=4012502>[析构]</buf>，可叠加<color=#F74848>10</color>层；火箭的负重降低<color=#F74848>130</color>；
<buf ID=4012502>[析构]</buf>最大层数<color=#F74848>+2</color>，使用火箭攻击携带<buf ID=4012502>[析构]</buf>的目标时，伤害提升<color=#F74848>20%</color>

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

700015.name: Rotation
700015.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if no damage was dealt this turn, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

401203.name: 重载
401203.describe: 使火箭的弹数完全回复，并获得<buf ID=7100403>[暴击率提升Ⅱ]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>1</color>回合，然后可使用剩余移动力继续行动

401204.name: 覆写轰击
401204.describe: 选择释放<skill activeSkill=4012041>[指令覆写]</skill>或<skill activeSkill=4012042>[火控覆写]</skill>

401205.name: 即时解析
401205.SpecificEffects: 遭受主动攻击时，遭受伤害降低<color=#F74848>10%</color>，对攻击者施加<color=#F74848>1</color>层<buf ID=4012502>[析构]</buf>，每回合最多触发<color=#F74848>2</color>次

401206.name: 崩解打击
401206.describe: 消耗<color=#F74848>2</color>发弹药，使用火箭攻击所选<range type=1>5×5</range>格范围内的所有目标，对每个部位造成<color=#F74848>0.25</color>倍范围伤害，此次攻击暴击率提升<color=#F74848>25%</color>

401207.name: 连锁反应
401207.SpecificEffects: 任意敌机行动后，若携带<buf ID=4012502>[析构]</buf>，额外获得<color=#F74848>1</color>层<buf ID=4012502>[析构]</buf>

401208.name: 歼灭信标
401208.describe: 选择<range type=1>5×5</range>格范围地格标记为[标注打击位置]，使用后技能切换为<skill activeSkill=4012082>[终局轰鸣]</skill>，切换后当前回合无法使用；双肩均装备火箭时才可使用

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

401241.name: 可控变量1
401241.SpecificEffects: 携带<buf ID=4012502>[析构]</buf>的敌方单位被击毁时，将所有<buf ID=4012502>[析构]</buf>层数转移至周围<color=#F74848>3</color>格内耐久值最高的敌机

400043.name: Power Innovation 3
400043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401244.name: 可控变量2
401244.SpecificEffects: 使用火箭攻击时伤害提升<color=#F74848>15%</color>，攻击大型单位时，伤害额外提升<color=#F74848>100%</color>

401245.name: 可控变量3
401245.SpecificEffects: 携带<color=#F74848>5</color>层及以上<buf ID=4012502>[析构]</buf>敌机被击毁时，[哈达威]回复<color=#F74848>1</color>AP，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>2</color>次

401246.name: 可控变量4
401246.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=4012502>[析构]</buf>触发<buf ID=900017>[固定伤害]</buf>时，本次火箭攻击每额外暴击<color=#F74848>1</color>次，<buf ID=900017>[固定伤害]</buf>额外增加<color=#F74848>1</color>次，最多增加<color=#F74848>3</color>次
